items.name: Hatched Wasp Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 16 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 no effect (1 round)

Stage 2 Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 Paralyzed (1 round)

items.name: Implant Eggs
items.text: The giant wasp lays eggs in an adjacent creature that is Paralyzed or Unconscious, exposing it to wasp larva disease.

items.name: Wasp Larva
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 18 Fortitude save

---

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1d6 days)

Stage 2 Drained 1 (1d4 days)

Stage 3 5d6 untyped damage, larva emerges (disease ends)
